test_command: NOT_CRAN=true OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 JULIA_NUM_THREADS=1 Rscript -e 'suppressMessages(devtools::load_all(".", quiet=TRUE)); testthat::test_file("tests/testthat/test-poisson-batch5-sd-regression.R", reporter="summary")'

result.count_method: count of passing-expectation dots on the summary-reporter line of the console log; no failure or skip markers present

oracle: Dense R Laplace marginal likelihood over the pair latent f~N(0,K), K=kronecker(A2,A1), eta=X beta+J f, J=diag(sd_pair*value)[pair,], y~Poisson(exp(eta)), evaluated at fitted parameters. Written in the test file with stats::dpois and base linear algebra, no drmTMB objective, so independent of the likelihood code under test. Not fully independent in fixtures: A1 and A2 come from drmTMB:::drm_phylo_tip_covariance, and predict()/coef() supply SDs and mu coefficients. Checks likelihood assembly at fitted parameters, not the optimiser.
checks: name-aligned SD predictions equal exp(X alpha) to 1e-8
logLik within 1e-4 of dense Laplace oracle
tolerances_copied_from_test: oracle 1e-4 absolute logLik; constant-SD 2e-5 relative logLik, 1e-4 mu coef; z_pair recovery within 0.5; row-order 1e-5; predicted SD vs exp(X alpha) 1e-8; nested bound 1e-3

linked_rows.what_exercised: phylo_interaction(1 | plant:pollinator, tree1, tree2) with sd(pair, level='phylogenetic_interaction') ~ z_pair
